# ethereum-optimism/docs Daily Update (Mar 17, 2026)
## OVERVIEW 
The day focused on significant documentation cleanup, removing outdated references to SuperchainERC20 and U19 upgrade notices. Several flaky tests were investigated and fixed, improving CI stability.

## KEY TECHNICAL DEVELOPMENTS

### Documentation Cleanup and Standardization
Outdated documentation related to SuperchainERC20 was entirely removed in preparation for a new Remote Controlled Token (RCT) standard. Additionally, notices for the U19 upgrade and revenue sharing guides were deleted as their scope has changed. This streamlines the documentation and removes irrelevant information. ([#2003](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/docs/pull/2003), [#2002](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/docs/pull/2002))

### Flaky Test Stabilization
Multiple flaky tests across various packages were investigated and fixed. This included resolving nonce races, addressing insufficient timeouts in CI environments, and correcting issues with sync propagation and test setup. These fixes significantly improve the reliability of the CI pipeline. ([#18137](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/docs/issues/18137), [#19588](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/docs/issues/19588), [#19583](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/docs/issues/19583), [#19584](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/docs/issues/19584), [#19586](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/docs/issues/19586), [#19589](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/docs/issues/19589), [#19591](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/docs/issues/19591), [#19610](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/docs/issues/19610), [#19608](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/docs/issues/19608))

## NEWLY OPENED PULL REQUESTS
No new pull requests were opened today.

## CLOSED ISSUES

### Test Stability Improvements
Several flaky tests were investigated and closed after fixes were implemented. These included `TestBreakTimestampInvariant` ([#18137](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/docs/issues/18137)), `TestExpiredMessage` ([#19588](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/docs/issues/19588)), `TestImplementations` ([#19583](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/docs/issues/19583)), and `TestExecMsgDifferTxIndex` ([#19589](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/docs/issues/19589)). The fixes addressed issues like nonce races, tight timeouts, and sync propagation.

### Supernode Reporting and Oracle Review
The issue regarding `op-supernode` reporting the current derived L1 instead of the verified L1 was closed as fixed ([#18651](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/docs/issues/18651)). Additionally, the investigation into Glamsterdam gas pricing impacts on precompile acceleration was closed, with further work tracked in a separate issue ([#19375](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/docs/issues/19375)).

### Blob Archiver Endpoint Issue
A newly opened issue regarding the `blob-archiver` not supporting the `/eth/v1/beacon/blobs/` endpoint was quickly closed and moved to the `blob-archiver` repository for resolution ([#19623](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/docs/issues/19623)).

## NEW ISSUES

### Flaky Test Tracking
New issues were opened to track investigations into flaky tests: `TestSupernodeInteropChainLag` ([#19610](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/docs/issues/19610)) and `TestUnsafeChainNotStalling_DisabledReqRespSync` ([#19608](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/docs/issues/19608)). These issues detail the flake counts and CI jobs affected.

## ACTIVE ISSUES

### op-node: Initial EL Sync UX and Correctness ([#17631](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/docs/issues/17631))
The discussion continues on the behavior of `op-node` marking the EL sync target as finalized, even if not truly finalized. `trianglesphere` proposed solutions including using a command-line flag or a trusted checkpoint provider for the finalized head, or an arbitrary delay. `karlfloersch` raised questions about the bug's specificity to light CL/interop and current mitigation strategies. `trianglesphere` clarified that the issue is more likely with light CL and that sequencer nodes are typically fully synced before service. `sebastianst` and `axelKingsley` discussed the implications for Snap Sync and derivation, with `axelKingsley` suggesting Snap Sync should follow the finalized L2 as a maximum target.

### [tracking]: Review kona-interop block hash oracle ([#18288](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/docs/issues/18288))
The remaining task for this issue is to ensure an integration/acceptance test exists to verify block lookups prior to the current history window.

### Supernode test coverage ([#19010](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/docs/issues/19010))
Progress has been made on deduplicating tests. A draft PR ([#19622](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/docs/pull/19622)) has been opened, deleting 3 tests (140 lines) that are now covered by equivalent tests in `op-acceptance-tests` via the shared `superfaultproofs` package. 10 tests remain in `op-e2e` that cover unique scenarios not yet ported.

### non-terminating CI job: memory-all-opn-op-geth ([#19563](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/docs/issues/19563))
`geoknee` noted that several ongoing PRs might address this non-terminating CI job and suggested re-evaluating the issue in a few days.
